title: Cache Tag Helper / view components / display templates / validation helpers
meaning: Cache Tag Helper caches generated output fragments in a view.
Cache can vary by route, query, user, cookie, header and similar values depending on helper attributes.
Expiration can be absolute, sliding or duration-based.
View components are reusable UI units with their own logic and view output.
Display/editor templates and validation helpers/tag helpers support consistent rendering of values and errors.
boundary_notes: R03 covers the generic built-in tag helper list and infrastructure.
